# asyntai Provider

Manage Asyntai AI chatbots as code: websites (AI agents), widget settings, AI instructions, knowledge base items and webhooks. Uses the [Asyntai REST API](https://asyntai.com/documentation/api/), which needs a paid Asyntai plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    asyntai = {
      source = "asyntai/asyntai"
    }
  }
}

# The API key comes from the ASYNTAI_API_KEY environment variable.
provider "asyntai" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Asyntai API key, from the API Settings page (https://asyntai.com/settings/api/). Can also be set with the `ASYNTAI_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) API address. Defaults to `https://asyntai.com`. Can also be set with the `ASYNTAI_BASE_URL` environment variable.
